title: Anti-Pollution Pink Clay & Charcoal Face Wash

details.description: Elevate your skincare routine with Everyuth Naturals Anti-Pollution Pink Clay & Charcoal Face Wash. This powerful yet gentle cleanser combines the purifying properties of pink clay and the adsorbing abilities of activated charcoal to deeply cleanse and detoxify your skin. The pink clay lovingly removes excess sebum, while the charcoal beads adsorb impurities from the skin's surface, helping to purify pores and leave your complexion feeling refreshed and renewed. Suitable for all skin types, this face wash not only cleanses but also helps protect your skin from the damaging effects of environmental pollutants, promoting a healthy, glowing appearance. Gently massage this formula onto damp skin, then rinse away to reveal a soft, smooth, and radiant complexion.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Moisten face and apply a small quantity.
2. Lather and gently massage it onto your face.
3. Rinse with water and pat dry.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool and dry place away from direct heat & sunlight
